blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Public and private motorists should budget for fuel purchases as diesel prices will rise again this week. In contrast, gasoline prices fell again as geopolitical conflicts continued to drive oil price volatility. In an advisory on Monday, the Department of Energy (DOE) said gasoline prices would drop by 30 centavos per liter.
